title: Strawberry Meringue Roulade
description: A light and airy meringue roulade filled with whipped cream and fresh strawberries.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 180°C. Line a 25 cm × 30 cm lamington tin with baking paper and lightly spray with oil to hold the paper in place.
In a medium bowl, beat egg whites with an electric mixer until soft peaks form. Gradually add caster sugar, beating continuously until the mixture is thick and glossy.
Gently fold in cornflour and vinegar until just combined.
Spread meringue evenly into the prepared tin. Bake for 15 minutes. Cool completely in the tin.
Turn meringue out onto a large sheet of baking paper. Spread whipped cream over the surface and scatter sliced strawberries on top.
Using the paper to guide, roll the meringue from the long side into a roulade shape. Transfer to a serving plate.
Dust generously with icing sugar and serve immediately.

notes.title: Serving Tip
notes.content: Best served immediately for maximum fluffiness. Can be made a few hours ahead — store covered in the refrigerator. The meringue will soften slightly but still taste excellent.

notes.title: Egg Whites
notes.content: Ensure the bowl and beaters are completely clean and grease-free before beating egg whites. Any trace of fat or yolk will prevent them from whipping properly.
